secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role key for database writes. Get it from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → service_role key.

secrets.name: BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Needed for Telegram webhook/bot integration.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret token for Telegram webhook verification. Set when configuring the webhook via /api/telegram/set-webhook.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_CALLBACK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign and verify Telegram inline callback data.

secrets.name: CE_VAULT_SANDBOX_API_KEY
secrets.description: Operator key required for sandbox write API commands (POST /api/v1/jobs, etc.).
